question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 K 组：葡萄牙 vs 刚果民主共和国（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K: Portugal vs DR Congo (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: Elo 差 337 分叠加葡萄牙全主力，实力差异显著；刚果（金）现实路径是防守拖平，爆冷取胜约一成。
one_liner_en: A 337-point Elo gap plus a full-strength Portugal squad makes this a heavy mismatch; DR Congo's realistic path is a defensive draw, with roughly a one-in-ten upset chance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 337 分：葡萄牙 1989（第 6）对刚果（金）1652（第 55），统计基线即约七成葡胜。
key_reasons.en: 337-point Elo gap: Portugal 1989 (rank 6) vs DR Congo 1652 (rank 55); the statistical baseline alone gives Portugal about 70%.

key_reasons.cn: 葡萄牙全员可用：5-19 公布 26 人名单，C 罗伤愈领衔第 6 次世界杯，热身赛连胜智利、尼日利亚。
key_reasons.en: Portugal at full strength: 26-man squad named May 19, Ronaldo recovered to captain a record 6th World Cup, with warm-up wins over Chile and Nigeria.

key_reasons.cn: 刚果（金）防守有组织但火力有限：0-0 平丹麦、1-2 负于刚被葡萄牙击败的智利，平局是其最现实的拿分路径。
key_reasons.en: DR Congo organized but blunt: 0-0 vs Denmark and a 1-2 loss to the Chile side Portugal just beat; a draw is their most realistic outcome.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11 gives p_stat 70.97/18.83/10.20; bounded evidence adjustment of 1pp from Portugal win to draw (DR Congo low-block solidity vs Denmark, cautious opener dynamics); 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.
